name: 6-acetyl-2-amino-3,7,8,9-… to L-glutamate
summary: A 6-step route from 6-acetyl-2-amino-3,7,8,9-tetrahydropyrimido[4,5-b][1,4]diazepin-4-one to L-glutamate(1−), ingested from Rhea. Every step is curated by Rhea and independently verified here to balance in mass and charge.

reactions.name: tRNA-guanine(15) transglycosylase
reactions.equation: guanosine(15) in tRNA + 7-cyano-7-carbaguanine = 7-cyano-7-carbaguanosine(15) in tRNA + guanine

reactions.name: archaeosine synthase
reactions.equation: 7-cyano-7-carbaguanosine(15) in tRNA + L-glutamine + H2O = archaeosine(15) in tRNA + L-glutamate

reactions.name: glutathione synthase
reactions.equation: gamma-L-glutamyl-L-cysteine + glycine + ATP = glutathione + ADP + phosphate + H(+)

reactions.name: CoA-glutathione reductase
reactions.equation: glutathione + NADP(+) + CoA = CoA-glutathione + NADPH + H(+)

reactions.name: aspartate dehydrogenase
reactions.equation: L-aspartate + NADP(+) + H2O = oxaloacetate + NH4(+) + NADPH + H(+)

reactions.name: aspartate dehydrogenase
reactions.equation: L-aspartate + NAD(+) + H2O = oxaloacetate + NH4(+) + NADH + H(+)

reactions.name: glutamate--cysteine ligase
reactions.equation: L-cysteine + L-glutamate + ATP = gamma-L-glutamyl-L-cysteine + ADP + phosphate + H(+)

reactions.name: methylarsonate reductase
reactions.equation: methylarsonate + 2 glutathione + H(+) = methylarsonous acid + glutathione disulfide + H2O

reactions.name: phospholipid-hydroperoxide glutathione peroxidase
reactions.equation: a hydroperoxy polyunsaturated fatty acid + 2 glutathione = a hydroxy polyunsaturated fatty acid + glutathione disulfide + H2O

reactions.name: hydroxyacylglutathione hydrolase
reactions.equation: an S-(2-hydroxyacyl)glutathione + H2O = a 2-hydroxy carboxylate + glutathione + H(+)

reactions.name: ethane-1-sulfonate + FMNH2 + O2 = acetaldehyde + FMN + sulfite + H2O + 2 H(+)
reactions.equation: ethane-1-sulfonate + FMNH2 + O2 = acetaldehyde + FMN + sulfite + H2O + 2 H(+)
